mentions.name: LMNO.lol
mentions.description: A blogging service where users drag and drop their markdown files to the web and get a blog. It focuses on simple, quirky blogs free of tracking, bloat, and paywalls.
mentions.problem: The web and blogs have lost themselves in tracking, bloat, and paywalls, and the quirkiness of the early web is missed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://LMNO.lol Drag and drop your markdown to the web and get a blog.

Also because the web/blogs lost itself in tracking, bloat, paywalls... and I miss some of the quirkiness.
